lines.1: 「Next time I'll do it properly. All right, I'll go after that girl who's on her own.」
lines.2: 「Just hearing you say that makes me nervous.」
lines.8: 「You've got a big attitude for such a shrimp!」
lines.9: 「What, so now you're taking it out on me because she blew you off? You're the worst!」
lines.10: 「Quit rising to every little jab. People will say you're small-minded too.」
lines.11: 「What do you mean, 'too'?! What else about me is small, huh? You stupid taco!」
lines.12: Well, her chest, her butt, her height, her mental age...
lines.13: 「Since you've obviously got energy to spare, why don't you go recruit someone?」
lines.14: 「You got it! I should tell them they'll get all the white rice they can eat, right?」
lines.15: 「On second thought, you can stay here.」
